ident_mandate_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 mandate
ident_mandate_intro: If you found this address inside a file, that file is a mandate: rules that say what an AI agent may do in a household.
ident_audit_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log entry
ident_audit_intro: If you found this address inside a file, the file holds entries of an audit log: the record of what agents asked for and what was decided, linked into a hash chain.
ident_audit_v1_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log entry of version 1
ident_audit_v1_intro: If you found this address inside a file, the file holds entries of an audit log, written in version 1 of the format. Version 1 is version 0 with more events, among them certificates, Certificate Transparency, remote access and relays. Entries of both versions can stand in the same log, linked into one hash chain.
ident_checkpoint_title: This URL identifies a Home-Mandate Specification v0 audit log checkpoint
ident_checkpoint_intro: This address names the signed statement of a checkpoint: proof that an audit log had a certain entry at a certain position, so later changes are noticed.
